name: read-eof-handling
title: Distinguish EOF from read errors
lesson: For read-like calls, a zero-byte result is EOF, not the same thing as a negative error result.
fix_goal: Handle negative read results as errors, zero as EOF, and positive values as bytes read.
fix_steps: Split read result handling into three branches: negative, zero, and positive.
Treat zero as EOF or completion according to the surrounding protocol.
Re-run the lab and confirm EOF is handled separately from errors.
